meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可查询 DepMap 数据：按基因名返回癌细胞系的 CRISPR 依赖分数、药物敏感性数据，并分析基因必需性、共必需伙伴及与突变或表达的相关性。
howto.when: 当用户提到基因依赖、合成致死、药物敏感性等关键词，或要求查询 DepMap 数据做靶点验证时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的 Chronos 依赖分数
say.note: 会返回 KRAS 在各肺癌细胞系的依赖分数并排序。

say.text: 分析 TP53 突变细胞系对 MDM2 的依赖性
say.note: 会比较突变与野生型细胞系的依赖差异。

say.text: 找出与 EGFR 共必需的基因
say.note: 会返回与 EGFR 依赖谱最相关的基因列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query DepMap data: return CRISPR dependency scores and drug sensitivity data for cancer cell lines by gene name, and analyze gene essentiality, co-essential partners, and correlations with mutations or expression.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions gene dependency, synthetic lethality, drug sensitivity, or asks to query DepMap data for target validation.

say_en.text: Check the Chronos dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns KRAS scores across lung cancer lines.

say_en.text: Analyze dependency on MDM2 in TP53-mutant cell lines.
say_en.note: Compares dependency in mutant vs. wild-type lines.
Returns genes most correlated with EGFR dependency.
